s.en: The balor's body begins to disintegrate!

s.en: died. Its body turned to black smoke and returned to

s.zh: ——束缚随之断开，留下的装备和物品掉在原地。外来者的灵魂不在这个世界，无法复活。
s.en: ; the binding broke with it, and the gear and items it carried dropped where it stood. An outsider's soul isn't in this world and can't be revived.
: it won't be sent back again and can be captured.

It's no longer in this world

用真名封住深渊裂口（用掉这张卷）
s.en: Seal the abyssal rift with the true name (uses up this scroll)

s.zh: （1.54.0）深渊学研究、深渊法阵、腐化和深渊事件。关掉后研究隐藏、事件不再触发；已有的束缚者和仆从保留。
s.en: (1.54.0) Demonology research, abyssal circles, taint and abyss events. When off, the research is hidden and events no longer trigger; existing bound ones and servants are kept.

关掉后二阶仪式只能召仆从，三阶整阶不可用，魅魔来访不触发。
s.en: When off, tier 2 rituals can only summon servants, tier 3 is entirely unavailable, and succubus visits don't trigger.

s.zh: 在地图上显示位面薄弱度
s.en: Show planar thinness on the map

s.zh: 在有深渊法阵或开过深渊裂口的地图左上角显示薄弱度。
s.en: Shows thinness at the top left of maps with an abyssal circle or that have had an abyssal rift.
